title: Decoy Pricing: The Useless Option That Changes Choices
description:
Decoy pricing means adding an option almost nobody buys, so your best deal looks like the obvious pick.
Follow MarketOpsTips for a quick marketing tip every morning.

#marketing #pricing #shorts

beats.say: Adding an option nobody wants can make people spend more.
In an experiment by Dan Ariely, people saw three plans.
Online only for 59 dollars. Print only for 125. Print plus online, also 125.
Almost nobody picked print alone. Most people picked the combo.
Then the print-only plan was removed. Now most people chose the cheaper online plan.
That useless option is called a decoy. It makes your best deal look like a steal.
Do your prices have a decoy yet?
